F1 and step 2.1 incorrectly identified the unscaled convolution with the h-dependent discrete derivative. The Statement itself is dimensionless and correct: s_n is the coefficient of z(1+z)(1-z)^(alpha-3). Repaired the two descriptions to state sum_j omega_j(n-j)^2=h^alpha partial_h^alpha v^n. Gamma recurrence and the generating-function ODE give c_m; Gautschi at x=n-alpha,q=alpha and the mean value theorem give the O(n^(beta-1)) remainder. This is nonfatal because that dimensionless coefficient proof never uses h.

The rejected output-interface concern is a false positive. The phrase output sequence V occurs only in the explicitly specified u_0=0 specialization. The algorithm returns U^n=u_0+V^n, so U^n=V^n there, including n=0. For general u_0 the Statement correctly calls V the sequence defined by the updates. Positive diagonal gives uniqueness; at a finite maximum the negative weights give (lambda+h^(-alpha)p_n)M<=G, and h(n+1)<=2T proves exactly the displayed bound. No item edit is needed.
